dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is where contestants may win ultimate glory. All the people of Natlan are welcome to take part.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Before, the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame would be held as needed in response to the Abyssal threat, but now, it's held purely as a contest.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: In the name of victory, may you all keep fighting until the very end.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Just remember, you must never foment conflict for its own sake. All malicious acts will be laid bare under the Pyro Archon's vigilant gaze.
